description: Experience contract for Scenario to iOS. The operator surface is a delivery console with one property no other ramp's has: some rows are permanently unsupported, because a Linux host cannot build for iOS and never will. The disposition vocabulary (pass / failed / unavailable / unsupported / not_run) is the most repeated element on every screen, and the distinction between terminal 'unsupported' and actionable 'unavailable' is the single most important thing the UI must convey.

journeys.title: Take a scenario from source to an installable app
Tell what can never work from what is merely blocked
